variants: Light. Oh, that's... that's good. I'd stopped believing in it. Who sent you? No, don't tell me. The clerk. He always worries.
So someone worked out my words. Good. I didn't leave any. Stupid of me. Help me up, if you would.

what.text: My windcatcher ran dry two areas back, and everything I carry went dark with it. Torches after that, then none. Then those things found me. And this place... it hums. Like the Wayfinder does, when you stand close. I didn't want to leave without what I came for.

rope.text: Here. Mine. I was saving it to use when I'd got what I came for. Use it when you're ready, or walk us out: I'm not going anywhere on my own.
